coverage: Complete inventoried authored research core and selected CI harvests, plus every validated latest checkpoint reference. Failed attempts and corrected/superseded variants retain original bytes. Explicit excluded-environment inventory documents scope; no claim to copy toolchains, caches or every raw download/Actions artifact.
path_mapping: Logical paths are relative to the closure research folder, except publication/ and external-work/. Historical absolute paths inside original records are retained as provenance. Resolve through content_path after reconstructing the ordered ZIP bytes; never execute an archived helper merely because it is present.
